episode_title: Save the Deal or Hand Back the Keys? Mark Kenney - Think Multifamily

real_qa.q: What happened to multifamily property values in Florida between 2022 and 2024 as interest rates and cap rates rose?
real_qa.r: In parts of Florida, cap rates went from 4.4% in 2022 to 7.5% by 2024, making properties completely underwater on their loans. Operators could not sell for their note amount, making it impossible to exit those positions.

real_qa.q: How much did insurance costs increase for multifamily properties during the 2023-2024 downturn?
real_qa.r: Insurance costs spiked dramatically during this period. Florida saw increases of 200-300%, one property in South Texas experienced a 600% increase going from 1.2 million to 3.6 million in one year, driven by higher risk in insurance and lack of capital in reinsurance markets.

real_qa.q: What property tax assessment increase did Think Multifamily experience on a 10 million dollar deal?
real_qa.r: One Think Multifamily property valued at roughly 10 million dollars had its property tax assessment frozen for four years at that valuation, then the county attempted to raise it to 21 million dollars in a single year with no supporting logic.
real_qa.requete: property tax assessment increase 10 million 21 million

real_qa.q: How many multifamily deals did Think Multifamily exit between 2024 and 2025?
real_qa.r: Think Multifamily exited 30 deals between 2024 and 2025. On many of these exits, they did not even attempt to bring in additional capital because the economics made absolutely no sense to continue investing.

real_qa.q: What is the relationship between tax recapture and accelerated cost segregation when selling multifamily properties at a loss?
real_qa.r: When syndicators and GPs sell properties with no profit after using accelerated cost segregation and exhausting net operating losses, they face recapture taxation. Investors can be taxed on recapture at rates up to 37.5% even if they lost their entire capital, and recapture is split between 1231, 1250, and 1245 provisions.
real_qa.requete: tax recapture accelerated cost segregation multifamily
